title: An opt or brew tree whose manifest records a dirty source would print the bare commit on its version line, not T4's <sha12>+dirty: devbin_tree_line keeps the recorded mark (latent; not in 0.1.16)
body:
The version line of an opt install or a brew keg whose manifest records a dirty source would print the bare commit, not T4's `<sha12>+dirty`. devbin_tree_line reads such a tree's commit from its manifest's `source_commit` and cuts the value to its first word (`sha="${sha%% *}"`), so a recorded `<sha> +dirty -- THESE BYTES MATCH NO COMMIT` prints as the bare twelve digits, the same line a clean tree at that commit prints. It is latent: publish_gate, the only writer of an opt or brew manifest, refuses a dirty tree, so no devbin writer records that form today. Found by cc's critic-shell review of stack 1 (0241 and 0244) on 2026-10-27, outside 0244's Done when, and filed by vc on cc's recommendation; low, and not in 0.1.16.

## Fix

devbin_tree_line keeps a recorded `+dirty`: before the value is cut to its first word, a value carrying ` +dirty` sets the line's dirty mark, so the line reads `<sha12>+dirty` as T4 has it. The one reader of the recorded form stays manifest_source_commit, and the sha field keeps 0244's rule (twelve hex digits or unknown).

## Done when

1. An arm in version.bats or doctor.bats gives an opt install a manifest recording `<sha> +dirty -- THESE BYTES MATCH NO COMMIT`, and the version line reads `(opt, <sha12>+dirty)`; the same manifest without the mark reads `(opt, <sha12>)`.
2. The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU, with the tree scans and help, and CI is green on the pushed head.

## Resolution

- An opt or brew tree whose manifest records a dirty source prints `<sha12>+dirty` on its version line, as T4 has it. devbin_tree_line reads a recorded ` +dirty` into the line's dirty mark before the value is cut to its commit. The sha field keeps 0244's rule.
- Landed on main at 1d11e7af.
- Arm: tests/unit/localinstall.bats, "an opt install whose manifest records a dirty source prints <sha12>+dirty on its version line, and the same commit without the mark prints the twelve alone (0277)".
- Desk evidence: hv's full run on rhadamanth, sealed at tmp/test/20261029-1314.bats.out and .bats.errors: 2824 ok and 2 not ok, neither of them this issue's.
